description: Unit tests for the RetrieveConnectionLogs class within the connectivity query commands of the Eclipse Ditto project. The class tests JSON serialization/deserialization, equality/hashCode, and immutability.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing RetrieveConnectionLogs behaviors including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and immutability.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the fromJson method correctly reconstructs a RetrieveConnectionLogs instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method correctly serializes a RetrieveConnectionLogs instance to its JSON form.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods conform to the expected contract using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Checks that RetrieveConnectionLogs instances are immutable, and that ConnectionId is also immutable.
